company.name: SimpleHash
company.shortDescription: SimpleHash is an NFT data platform that specializes in infrastructure for multi-chain NFT indexing and querying.
company.description: SimpleHash is a REST and webhook-based API that provides the ability to query NFT metadata, media, and transaction history, including sales, listings, and floor prices, across multiple chains. They build APIs and developer tooling to abstract away this complexity for developers. They provide preview versions of the relevant media file within the previews field.

productsAndServices.description: A REST API providing access to token and NFT data, including market prices, metadata, ownership, and transaction history across 80+ blockchain networks.
productsAndServices.name: SimpleHash Multi-Chain Token & NFT API

productsAndServices.description: A high-throughput Kafka-based streaming service delivering real-time token and NFT data streams for large-scale ingestion and processing.
productsAndServices.name: SimpleHash Kafka Streaming Service

productsAndServices.description: A system that maintains up-to-date NFT metadata and cached media previews, including dynamic refreshing and spam filtering.
productsAndServices.name: NFT Metadata and Media Management

productsAndServices.description: A spam scoring system that evaluates NFT collections to identify and filter out likely spam or low-quality assets.
productsAndServices.name: Spam Scoring and Filtering for NFT Collections

productsAndServices.description: Dedicated enterprise support and SLAs providing rapid assistance and guaranteed uptime for mission-critical NFT and token data services.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise Support and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,689,519 to $8,364,141, a 1.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 33 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
